d: Is a Trump–JD Vance rift emerging over Israel, Iran and foreign policy? As Vance distances himself from Benjamin Netanyahu, Firstpost examines whether the move signals a deeper White House divide. Meanwhile, France’s student-led protests have sparked accusations against immigrants, with Donald Trump and Jordan Bardella fuelling anti-migrant rhetoric. Hem Kaur Saroya examines the political narratives surrounding the unrest, the reality on the ground, and how today’s demonstrations compare with France’s long history of protests.
